[31m+ export function startBackgroundImageJobMonitor([39m
[31m+     options: MonitorOptions = {},[39m
[31m+ ): () => void {[39m
[31m+     let disposed = false;[39m
[31m+     let timer:[39m
[31m+         ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>[39m
[31m+         | null = null;[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const schedule = () => {[39m
[31m+         if (disposed) return;[39m
[31m+         if (timer) clearTimeout(timer);[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+         if ([39m
[31m+             typeof document !== 'undefined'[39m
[31m+             && document.visibilityState[39m
[31m+                 !== 'visible'[39m
[31m+         ) return;[39m

[31m+         if (disposed) return;[39m

[31m+             options,[39m
[31m+         );[39m
[31m+         schedule();[39m
[31m+     };[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const activate = () => {[39m
[31m+         if (!disposed) void tick();[39m
[31m+     };[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const onVisibilityChange = () => {[39m
[31m+         if ([39m
[31m+             document.visibilityState[39m
[31m+             === 'visible'[39m
[31m+         ) {[39m
[31m+             activate();[39m
[31m+         } else if (timer) {[39m
[31m+             clearTimeout(timer);[39m
[31m+             timer = null;[39m
[31m+         }[39m
[31m+     };[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const onFocus = () => activate();[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     document.addEventListener([39m
[31m+         'visibilitychange',[39m
[31m+         onVisibilityChange,[39m
[31m+     );[39m
[31m+     window.addEventListener([39m
[31m+         'focus',[39m
[31m+         onFocus,[39m
[31m+     );[39m
[31m+[39m
[31m+     const appListenerPromise =[39m
[31m+         Promise.resolve([39m
[31m+             App.addListener([39m
[31m+                 'appStateChange',[39m
[31m+                 state => {[39m
[31m+                     if (state.isActive) {[39m
[31m+                         activate();[39m
[31m+                     }[39m

[31m+         const identity = job.clientRequestId || job.id;[39m
